accepted.quote: It is important that the OIG have a sufficient operating budget to capitalize on two laws (P.L. 117-165 and P.L. 117-166), which extended the statute of limitations for fraud in the PPP and EIDL programs to 10 years, as well as H.R. 4495, the SBA Fraud Enforcement Extension Act
accepted.bill: H.R. 4495, the SBA Fraud Enforcement Extension Act
accepted.rationale: The legislator states that sufficient OIG funding is important to use extended fraud statutes including H.R. 4495, indicating support for small-business fraud enforcement.
